model.recipe: R3D-18 Kinetics-400, layer4 + new 2-class fc trainable, Adam (fc 1e-3, layer4 1e-5), sqrt class weights, batch 8, 8 epochs, best epoch 8 by validation PR-AUC (max window)
model.data: SCVD via clean_split_manifest.csv; validation = 15% of train clusters by MD5 hash (400 clips, 78 clusters)

threshold_note: Interim. spike_threshold 0.97 chosen on validation: catches 79% of dangerous clips (max window) while flagging 4% of normal scenes (23% of normal clips; most false alarms come from one large normal scene). alert_threshold kept at 0.67: 1-second validation clips cannot calibrate the 4-window average. Recalibrate both with video_calibration.py on footage from the deployment cameras.
